project_type: Python PDF-to-HTML reproduction fidelity workshop. Reproduces 46 SARS exam-result PDFs (18 secondary + 28 primary) as HTML+CSS templates that render, through headless Chromium (agent-browser), to PDFs pixel-compared against immutable reference PDFs in corpus/.
build_system: uv (uv sync). Makefile wraps every command with `uv run`. No compiled build step.
test_framework: pytest 9.1.1 (uv run pytest). Tests in tests/: test_fidelity.py (reads output/*/report.json and enforces gates), test_catalog.py, test_evidence.py, test_templates.py. pytest config in pyproject.toml sets pythonpath=['.'] and testpaths=['tests'].
build_command: uv sync   (dependencies already installable; poppler + fonts installed via `make setup`)
test_command: uv run pytest   (aka `make test`). Lint: `uv run ruff check .` (aka `make lint`). Combined: `make check`.
verification_instructions: 1) `make setup` installs poppler-utils + liberation fonts + downloads Arial/Times (msttcorefonts) into /usr/share/fonts/msttcore. 2) `make doctor` must print 'environment ready' (all binaries + licensed faces present) BEFORE any fidelity number is trustworthy. 3) Per-report loop: `make convert-one LEVEL=<level> REPORT=<report_key>` runs scaffold->render->tune->scaffold->render->compare and writes output/<level>/<key-with-dashes>/{rendered.pdf,report.json,diff-page-NN.png} plus updates catalog status. 4) `uv run python -m tools.compare <level> <report_key>` re-measures an existing render. 5) `make status` regenerates the README conversion-status table from report.json. 6) `make test` must stay green. NOTE: report_key uses underscores on the CLI (council_schools_rank) but the output/extract/template directory uses dashes (council-schools-rank).
snapshot_or_generated_files: output/<level>/<key>/rendered.pdf, report.json, and diff-page-NN.png are generated AND committed (they are the reviewable proof). templates/<level>/<key>/{fixture.json,report.css,template.html,bindings.yaml,calibration.json} are generated by scaffold/tune. extract/<level>/<key>/{spans,rules,geometry,fonts}.json + page-NN.png + embedded-fonts/ are generated by tools.extract. README.md conversion-status table is regenerated by tools.status. Regenerate rendered.pdf/report.json/diff via `make convert-one` (or tools.render + tools.compare). Regenerate the README table via `make status`. corpus/ is READ-ONLY reference and must NEVER be edited.
setup_instructions: cd /projects/sandbox/mussannoni; `uv sync` (or it auto-syncs on first `uv run`); `bash scripts/setup-environment.sh` (== make setup) to install poppler + fonts. Network is OPEN in this sandbox: dnf install poppler-utils/liberation fonts/cabextract and curl of corefonts arial32/arialb32/times32 from sourceforge all succeed. VERIFIED WORKING: poppler 24.08.0 installed, Arial/Times resolve via fc-match, agent-browser renders a valid PDF, tools.compare produces metrics.
environment_constraints: Network mode is effectively OPEN (sourceforge + pypi reachable, dnf works) - `make setup` completes fully. Render engine is `agent-browser` (headless Chromium wrapper) which IS installed at /root/.nvm/.../bin/agent-browser and VERIFIED to produce valid PDFs. There is NO standalone chromium/chromium-browser/weasyprint on PATH - render goes exclusively through agent-browser (see tools/render.py). All Chromium work must stay under the project tree (work/ dir) per README snap-confinement note. Do NOT edit anything in corpus/. `make fetch`/`make catalog` hit live SARS listing pages and are NOT needed - the 46 corpus PDFs are already committed.
contribution_requirements: Fidelity gates are NEVER relaxed (docs/01-fidelity.md, enforced in tools/compare.py THRESHOLDS and tests/test_fidelity.py): per page SSIM>=0.98, differing pixels<=0.5% at 300dpi, text drift<=1.0pt, column-edge drift<=0.5pt, text_content_equal, page count/size/orientation equal. A report is `done` only when every page passes; otherwise `wip`. Templates must carry NO literal sample values (only fixture.json holds reference numbers) - enforced by test_templates.py. Everything is measured, never hand-typed (extract.py reads via PyMuPDF; tune.py measures residuals). Step 9 of the loop adjusts CSS/placement logic, never the reference and never the thresholds.
key_patterns: Pipeline: tools/extract.py (PyMuPDF -> spans.json/rules.json/geometry.json/fonts.json; captures per-span `rotation` via rotation_of() and per-glyph char_offsets). tools/evidence.py (rehydrates Span/Rect/Style; Span.rotation, Span.char_offsets). tools/grid.py (reconstructs table: column/row edges from gridline rectangles, colspan/rowspan merges, attach_text() assigns each span to smallest containing cell by baseline origin, measure_alignment() SKIPS cells containing any rotated run). tools/scaffold.py build_lines() places each run absolutely inside its cell: for rotation==90 it computes left=origin_x-baseline_drop-cell.x, top=baseline-cell.y and applies .rot90 CSS transform rotate(-90deg); rotation 180/270 fall through to the horizontal branch (no 270/180 spans exist in this corpus - ALL 728 rotated spans are rotation==90 across 40 of 46 reports). letter_spacing() distributes advance-width difference across a run so it starts+ends on the reference. character_chunks() splits per-glyph where reference offsets demand. tools/tune.py measures median residual per (face,size,rotation) and writes calibration.json; correction_for() applies it; by_size has a >=5 sample floor but by_face does NOT (single-sample rotated corrections like dx=-1.795 n=1 are noisy). tools/render.py renders via agent-browser. tools/compare.py rasterises both PDFs with pdftoppm at 300dpi, matches spans by text+nearest-distance, computes SSIM/pixel-delta/drift.
directory_structure: corpus/{primary,secondary}/*.pdf (READ-ONLY reference, 28+18). extract/<level>/<key>/ (machine-read evidence + review rasters). templates/_shared/ (reset.css, tokens.css, fonts/) and templates/<level>/<key>/ (template.html, report.css, fixture.json, bindings.yaml, calibration.json). output/<level>/<key>/ (rendered.pdf, report.json, diff-page-NN.png - committed). tools/ (pipeline). tests/. docs/00-03. catalog/ (reports.yaml with per-report status, subjects.yaml, dedup.md). scripts/setup-environment.sh. Makefile. Directory names use dashes; CLI report_key uses underscores.
baseline_findings: Committed README status: 46/46 wip, 11/262 pages pass every gate, SSIM>=0.98 on only 1/46 reports, differing-pixels<=0.5% on 0/46. Worst reports are the rank reports carrying rotated R/RANK, C/RANK, PERFORMANCE SUMMARY headers: region_schools_rank_overall SSIM 0.882, region_schools_rank_government 0.876, council_schools_rank 0.899, region_schools_rank_private 0.900, council_school_rank_ufaulu_alama 0.884, region_shule_nafasi_jumla 0.893. CONCRETE ROTATED-HEADER DEFECTS FOUND: (1) A single visual rotated heading like 'PERFORMANCE SUMMARY' arrives from PyMuPDF as 3 separate spans (E / 'SUMMARY ' / 'PERFORMANC') placed as 3 disjoint rotated runs at different top offsets (2.38/3.91/7.51) instead of one continuous rotated string. (2) Multi-glyph rotated headers (R/RANK, C/RANK) get letter_spacing_pt=0.0 in the fixture - the advance-width distribution that horizontal runs get is not effectively applied along the vertical axis, so glyphs accumulate drift. (3) tune.py rotated by_face corrections are computed from as few as 1 sample (e.g. Arial-BoldMT|3.6|90 dx=-1.795 n=1) with no minimum-sample floor, injecting ~1.8pt of noise into rotated header placement. A clean re-render+compare of council_schools_rank produced worst_text_drift 1.3pt (FAILS the 1.0pt gate) and SSIM 0.775, showing rotated header placement is the live failure. NOTE: an initial re-render before `make setup` scored differently; always run `make setup`+`make doctor` first so metrics are comparable to the committed baseline.
measurement_protocol: To quantify before/after: pick the worst rotated-header reports (secondary council_schools_rank, region_schools_rank_overall, region_schools_rank_government; primary council_school_rank_ufaulu_alama, region_shule_nafasi_jumla). Record current output/<..>/report.json summary (worst_ssim, worst_pixel_delta_percent, worst_text_drift_pt, worst_column_drift_pt, pages_passing). Re-run `make convert-one` for each after code changes and compare the same fields. The rotated-header text-drift and SSIM on these reports are the primary success signal. Sub-pixel antialiasing jitter (documented in docs/01-fidelity.md) means literal 100% pixel-identity across all pages is not fully attainable via this rasteriser; the achievable, verifiable win is eliminating the rotated-header/merge drift and raising SSIM/lowering text-drift on the rotation-heavy reports, without regressing the reports that already score best.
